model.description: OpenRouter model slug, vendor-prefixed (e.g. 'anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5', 'openai/gpt-4o-mini'). Free text accepted for new/custom models. The model picker lists the live catalog with per-model pricing; only text-generation models are shown.

reasoningEffort.description: Reasoning effort level. Only applies to models that support reasoning; 'disabled' turns it off.

batchMode.description: Batch by target language or by entry

useStructuredOutput.description: Force JSON-array output via a json_schema response_format. Only enable for models/routes that honor response_format; leave off otherwise.
